correctness.rationale: Independent Fano incidence construction with 7 nonzero points and 7 nonzero dual covectors under zero pairing yields 21 edges and independent-set cardinalities (1,14,70,154,147,56,14,2). Independent GF2 simplicial boundary rank elimination gives (13,57,97,44,12,2), hence mod2 and, with Euler/characteristic-zero comparison plus independent GF3 source cross-check, six-dimensional rational degree-3 homology and no other reduced ranks. Exhaustive independent generation of all 168 invertible row maps with contragredient dual-line actions and signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz yields trace distribution 1:(6),21:(-2),56:(0),42:(2),48:(-1) at element orders 1,2,3,4,7; the augmented empty-face contribution and parity signs are essential. Inner product of character with itself is 2, trivial multiplicity 0, so the degree-6 rational character splits over C as the two conjugate degree-3 irreducibles, giving irreducibility over Q. This is a finite complex, so complete exact enumeration is an exhaustive certificate of these finite ranks, not an infinite-family theorem.
residual_risks: This is a rational representation conclusion only, neither integral lattice nor full graph automorphism including dualities.
